table.retrieve:
SELECT
	PrInvCode = dbo.PrLedger.PrInvCode, 
	date = dbo.PrLedger.date, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.PrLedger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.PrLedger.flatdisc,   
	misccharges = dbo.PrLedger.misccharges, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.PrLedger.invgstperc1, 
	invsalestax = dbo.PrLedger.salestax,
	remarks = dbo.PrLedger.remarks,
	SuppCode = dbo.PrLedger.SuppCode,
	looseqty = dbo.PrDetail.looseqty, 
	bonusqty = dbo.PrDetail.bonusqty, 
	packqty  = PrDetail.packqty,  
	packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	price = dbo.PrDetail.PrPrice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.PrDetail.discperc, 
	packunits = dbo.PrDetail.packunits,    
	unitsalestax = dbo.PrDetail.unitsalestax, 
	gstperc = dbo.PrDetail.gstperc, 
	batch = dbo.PrDetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.PrDetail.expiry,    
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, PrLedger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, PrLedger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, PrLedger.date)))), 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name ,
	doctype = Case dbo.PrLedger.PrCatCode When 4 Then 'Cash' When 5 Then 'Credit' Else 'Opening' End
FROM 
	dbo.PrLedger, 
	dbo.PrDetail,    
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts
WHERE
	dbo.PrLedger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.PrLedger.date <= :ad_EndDate and 
	(dbo.PrLedger.SuppCode >= ( Case :al_SuppCode When 0 Then 7 Else :al_SuppCode End) and 
	dbo.PrLedger.SuppCode  <= ( Case :al_SuppCode When 0 THEN (Select max(SuppCode) From Supplier) Else :al_SuppCode End )) and
	dbo.PrLedger.PrCatCode IN (4,5,6) and
	dbo.PrLedger.PrInvCode = dbo.PrDetail.PrInvCode and  
	dbo.PrDetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.PrLedger.SuppCode = dbo.accounts.acccode 
ORDER BY dbo.accounts.name , dbo.PrLedger.PrInvCode

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round(looseqty * price * (1 - itemdiscperc * .01) * gstperc *.01, 2) + Round( (looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax, 2)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round(looseqty * price * (1 - itemdiscperc * .01) * gstperc *.01, 2) + Round( (looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax, 2) + (looseqty * price * (1 - itemdiscperc * .01))

objects.name: c_invleveldisc
objects.expression: Sum (( (  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) ) ) for group 2 )  *  ( Sum(invdiscperc for group 2 distinct prinvcode) * .01)

objects.name: c_overallsaletax
objects.expression: Round(((sum(looseqty * price * (1 - itemdiscperc * .01) for group 2) * (1 - invdiscperc * .01)) - flatdisc + misccharges) *  invgstperc1 * .01, 0)

objects.name: c_netamount
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( Round(looseqty * price * (1 - itemdiscperc * .01) * gstperc *.01, 2) for group 2 ) + Sum ( Round( (looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax, 2)  for group 2 ) + c_overallsaletax, f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon')) + Round(Sum((looseqty * price * (1 - itemdiscperc * .01)) for group 2) - flatdisc - c_invleveldisc +  misccharges +  invsalestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))
